source: Exact ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS, visible LCD and native key sequences, 2026-11-19

sheet-fill-value-math-persistent.reason: Copying a constant ERROR cell completes without a popup; the extra second Back therefore left Spreadsheet. The accepted persistence/copy cases were remeasured without that extra Back.

sheet-fill-value-error-copy.reason: Copying a constant ERROR cell completes without a popup; the extra second Back therefore left Spreadsheet. The accepted persistence/copy cases were remeasured without that extra Back.

sheet-fill-value-error-copy-back.reason: Copying a constant ERROR cell completes without a popup; the extra second Back therefore left Spreadsheet. The accepted persistence/copy cases were remeasured without that extra Back.

observations: Repeated copies of partially invalid references keep the whole reference frozen: =?1+1 remains =?1+1 and =A?+1 remains =A?+1 after copying diagonally.
Fill Value 1/A1 over B1:B3 with source 1,0,2 reports Math ERROR but finishes all cells: 1, ERROR, 0.5. The previous B3=9 is overwritten. Back returns to the grid.
The fixed ERROR value remains after A2 changes from 0 to 2. Editing starts blank; replacing it by 5 succeeds. Six occupied value cells, including ERROR, leave 2296 of 2380 bytes available.
Copying or cutting a fixed ERROR value transfers it without another error popup; successful paste moves down. Copy keeps paste mode until Back; cut clears paste mode and removes the source.
Fill Formula stores =1/A1, =1/A2, =1/A3 throughout the same range. Math ERROR leaves all formulas registered; changing A2 from 0 to 2 updates B2 to 0.5.
Three exploratory observations affected by an extra Back after a successful ERROR-value copy are kept under probes and excluded; the accepted sequences were remeasured.
